description.it: Copie (non ritirate) che non sono mai uscite; si può limitare a quelle acquisite prima di una data.
description.en: Copies (not withdrawn) that never went out; can be limited to those acquired before a date.

sql: SELECT i.barcode AS barcode, b.title AS title, b.author AS author, i.call_number AS call_number, i.acquisition_date AS acquired FROM item i JOIN biblio b ON b.id = i.biblio_id WHERE i.status <> 'withdrawn' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.item_id = i.id) AND (:acquiredBefore IS NULL OR COALESCE(i.acquisition_date, date(i.created_at)) < :acquiredBefore) ORDER BY b.title, i.barcode
